notes: Posted 10 August 2001; the post calls itself 'a pre-Coruscant version' and has no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Stuff' (10): Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Epic Duel, Start Your Engines!, Watto's Box or IAO, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Executor: Holotheatre, Sebulba's Podracer, Executor: Meditation Chamber and Visage Of The Emperor; these count toward the deck.
Posted 'Watto's Box or IAO' is one slot that the author fills with either Watto's Box or Imperial Arrest Order depending on the opponent; it is printed as written and counted once.
Total is 59 as published. The strategy says the author later put No Escape in place of one Intruder Missile; that change is not in the list.
Posted 'Visage' (Starting) dested the effect Visage Of The Emperor that Hunt Down deploys, not the Visage starship; with 'Visage of the Emp.' under Effects that is two copies, as published.

Posted 'Hunt Down/ I dont care' dested the objective; 'Epp Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Maul' Darth Maul (Tatooine; the card titled Maul is a later virtual card); 'Mara Jade ,THE' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Ig with gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; '4-lom with gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Emperor Palpy' Emperor Palpatine.

Posted 'Boba Fett in ship' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Dengar in Ship' Dengar In Punishing One; 'Zuckuss in ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Mauls stick' Maul's Lightsaber; 'Maras stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Vaders stick' Vader's Lightsaber; 'Intruder Missle' the Dark Intruder Missile (Dark).

Posted 'Crush' dested Crush The Rebellion; 'Secret Plans' (under Effects) the Special Edition Effect; 'Hoth docking bay' Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Dark); 'Yavin docking bay' Yavin 4: Docking Bay (Dark); 'Boonta Eve Podrace' and 'Podrace Arena' the Dark printings.
The strategy mentions playing the deck 'at the tournament' without naming it, so the deck stays general.
